_meta.description: Formal scenario corpus (Phase 322). A scenario chains HTTP steps into a detection flow the plain reflect-probe loop cannot express; the canonical shape is stored XSS (write a token-marked payload, read it back, semantically verify the token rendered).
_meta.format: See the xssentinel/core/scenarios.py module docstring -- this file is validated by the same loader (scenarios missing id/steps or carrying an incomplete step are skipped with a warning, not silently mis-run).
_meta.load_with: --scenarios builtin   (or pass this file's path to --scenarios)
contribution_contract: Every scenario needs: id (unique), title, match (may be {}), steps (>=1).
Every step needs: method + path; optional name/param/payload/verify.
Prefer match.param_names filtering over guessing app-specific paths -- a scenario whose write path does not exist on the target costs two requests and confirms nothing.
Use {self} for write-and-read-back-same-page flows instead of hardcoding a path.
The payload should carry an execution point (alert(...) / on*= / javascript:) so verify_semantic can prove execution, not just reflection.
non_goals: GET-write self-echo: a read step re-sends the param carrying the bare token, so a stateful GET page overwrites its own write; a stateless reflecting GET is the main probe loop's job with better evidence. Measured on a live fixture (Phase 322 tests).
